So, unfortunately there is no real movement in that repo.

This issue still occurs with [@actions/artifact@5.0.1](https://github.com/actions/toolkit/blob/main/packages/artifact/RELEASES.md) (current latest version) which is used by [actions/download-artifact@7.0.0](https://github.com/actions/download-artifact/releases/tag/v7.0.0) (also current latest version).

View logs of https://github.com/actions/download-artifact/actions/workflows/test.yml?query=branch%3Amain

Select the most recent run
- Build (ubuntu-latest)
  - Job `Download artifact A`
    Scroll down to `DEP0005`

Note [DEP0005 deprecation](https://nodejs.org/docs/latest-v24.x/api/deprecations.html#DEP0005) warning.

For example, https://github.com/actions/download-artifact/actions/runs/20175434709/job/57922122793 from Fri, 12 Dec 2025:

No change for  [@actions/artifact@5.0.3](https://github.com/actions/toolkit/blob/main/packages/artifact/RELEASES.md)

https://github.com/actions/toolkit/blob/a2986ee5119862b6b4ca3c77c5e4b7d5775a89b7/packages/artifact/package.json#L55

The issue remains unresolved.

I assume you marked unzip-stream because that is the original source of the issue.

Here the next step upsteam: https://github.com/mhr3/unzip-stream/issues/55

- https://github.com/mhr3/unzip-stream/issues/55

It looks like `unzip-stream` is no longer maintained: Last commit 2024-04-20

`@Maintainers of actions/toolkit`, would you consider replacing the unmaintained fork with a different or new one?

Possible options are [`@zip-js/zip-js`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@zip.js/zip.js) (maintained) or [`unzipper`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/unzipper), which seems to have received at least minimal maintenance recently (although no releases), or a new community fork of unzip-stream. Or an entirely different unzip library.

If you are fine with a replacement, I'll PR the required changes.
<details>
<summary>If you would be ok with/prefer a new community fork, I'm willing to start it, if I get at least another reviewer/maintainer.</summary>

Steps:

- Bump to Node 20+
- Fix deprecation warnings (only)
- Release First Maintainance Release
- ...
- Bump to Node 22+ (current LTS)
- Modernize tooling
- Possibly migrate to TypeScript (while remaining API compatible)
- Possibly migrate to ESM (only)

</details>

@Samirat 

This issue is more than one year old with so far no response from any maintainer. Would you be able to take a look?

It does seem unacceptable for a critical component of GitHub Actions commonly used in the publishing of release artifacts to be depending on an unmaintained NPM package with a known security vulnerability.
